title: Read-Only Zotero Local API Integration
validation: read-only loopback and export fallback scenario
acceptance_criteria: Documented Zotero Local HTTP API (localhost:23119/api/) is used without direct SQLite coupling or Zotero writes.
Adapter normalizes Zotero bibliographic metadata into ResearchCandidate and passes through canonical Research API.
Loopback-only network boundary is strictly enforced; arbitrary remote host overrides are rejected.
Zotero item keys remain provenance and cannot overwrite durable identifier precedence or canonical identity.
Zotero absence, connection refusal, or 403 degrades only Zotero capability while standard export/manual paths remain fully operational.
description: Optional read-only Zotero Local HTTP API adapter converting local bibliography items into canonical research candidates with permanent export fallback.
